content: Tanoha ꞌana topaihowao ꞌadi gwae hegehegedi
“Yehoba ꞌina loina gide tuwa loheya ꞌaigeda maꞌina tanoha, loheyaina ꞌabwakululu ꞌitoholowa ma ꞌitauya ꞌasai ta tupwadi topaihowao ꞌitoediya sabi paihowa ꞌina tanoha.
Coinega loina ꞌilaguya ma ꞌabehega sabwelo ꞌaigeda paihowa ꞌana maisa kina ꞌaigeda, ta sitagwala. Coinega ꞌihesumanediya ta sitauya ꞌina tanoha sabi paihowa.
“Ma sinala ꞌisaehanema ta loheyaina ꞌitauya hila ꞌasaina ꞌoina, ta tomota tupwadi ꞌilobediya simiyamiya bwagabwaga.
Coinega ꞌibwauwedima ta ꞌigwaeya, ‘Comi wete watauya ꞌigu tanoha wapaihowa, ma ꞌimi paihowa ꞌana maisa dumwaluna yaꞌebwaegomi.’ Coinega sitauya tanoha.
“Coinega ꞌasudiladila ma wete lahilahiya ꞌitauya hila ꞌasaina ꞌoina, ta nobwa tomota tupwadi ꞌilobediya, ta ꞌibwauwediya ta wete ꞌihesumanediya, ta sitauya ꞌina tanoha.
“Ma lahilahi moisa wete ꞌilatu hila ta ꞌitauya ꞌasai ma tomota wete tupwadi ꞌilobediya ta ꞌihesilalediya, ꞌigwae, ‘Toꞌaha weyahina sabwelo mabwaiyana wamiyamiya bwagabwaga?’
“Ma sigwaeya, ‘Weyahina geya ꞌeta taiya ꞌibwauwemai sabi paihowa.’ Ta loheyaina ꞌigwaeya, ‘Comi wete watauya ꞌigu tanoha ma wapaihowa.’

“Coinega boi hohau ꞌoina tanoha toniwagana ꞌina paihowa ꞌana toꞌitayahi ꞌihegwaeya, ꞌigwae, ‘Topaihowao mabwaiyadi ꞌubwauwedima ma ꞌadi maisa ꞌuꞌebwaedi, taudi tonaoma hauhaudi ꞌoidiyega ꞌuhegaina ma ꞌadi maisa ꞌuꞌebwaꞌebwaedi, ma ꞌana siga taudi sabwelo mabwaiyana ꞌoina sipaihoweya.’
Coinega taudi lahilahimo ꞌoina sipaihowa sinaoma ma ꞌadi maisa kina ꞌaigeda ꞌaigeda siꞌeweya.

Muliyetega mabwaiyadi wete topaihowaedi sinaoma ta ꞌadi maisa kina ꞌaigeda ꞌaigeda siꞌeweya. Ma topaihowa nugenugetadi wete, taudi sabwelo mabwaiyana ꞌoina sipaihowa, sinaoma ta ꞌidi nuwatuhu ꞌabehega nata maisa ꞌana loheposeyana siꞌewa, ta geya, taudi wete kina ꞌaigeda tuwa siloꞌahala.
Coinega ꞌidi kina siꞌewediya ma tanoha toniwagana ꞌoina silomugiya,
ma sigwaeya, ‘Tomota hauhaudi sinaoma ꞌidi paihowa tuta toꞌutoꞌupanamo, ma tauma sabwelo mabwaiyana hala ꞌalona ꞌapaihowa, ma taudi ꞌadi maisa gide tuwa mabwaiyama mahemahetena.’
“Ma badaina ꞌaigeda ꞌoidiyega ꞌihegwaeya, ꞌigwae, ‘Ciyagu, geya wete yaꞌabowego, weyahina ꞌida loina nugenugetana ꞌabehega kina ꞌaigeda tuwamo ꞌuꞌewa.
Cino kina bewa ꞌuꞌewa ma ꞌutauya. Ma taugu ꞌigu loina ꞌabehega tomota hauhaudi sinaoma ꞌadi maisa yaꞌebwaedi ꞌowa gide ꞌa maisa.
Maisa bewa taugu ꞌigu ꞌebeloina. Sahena ꞌomi waloiloina. Sahena ꞌigu helau tomota ꞌoidiya weyahina waheꞌipiꞌipi.’
Coinega taudi simulimuliya ꞌabwa sinugeta, ma taudi sinugenugeta ꞌabwa simuliya.”
Yesu ꞌina ꞌamasa ꞌabwa weyahina ꞌigwaeya
Cabwa Yesu Yelusalema weyahina ꞌihanehane ma ꞌana tomuliyao site tuwelo ꞌitoediya ꞌeda papalina, ma taudimo, ma ꞌihegwaediya,
ꞌigwae, “Bewa tuwa tahanehane Yelusalema, ma nobwa ꞌagu totebaina taugu Loheyaiguina ꞌitebaegau topwaoli madoudi ma loina ꞌana toheꞌitao ꞌoidiya, ma ꞌigu ꞌamasa weyahina siloina,
ma muliyetega siꞌebwayegau taudi geya meYudiya ꞌoidiya, ma silotuyanegau, ma balaeyega sisapigau, ma kelose ꞌoina situtu hepatugau, ma sabwelo hetoina ꞌoina Yehoba ꞌiꞌabihe toholo hilegau.”
Yemesa ma Yoni sinadiu ꞌina ꞌahwanoi Yesu ꞌoina
Muliyetega Sebedi mwanena manatunao sinaoma ta sinadiuina Yesu ꞌoina ꞌiꞌetuluha ma ꞌiꞌahwanoiya ꞌoina.

Ta Yesu ꞌigwaeya, “Toꞌaha nuwanuwau?” Ma wahineina ꞌigwaeya, “Nuwanuwagu ma natugwao ꞌoidiya ꞌutagwala ma ꞌeguma tutaina ꞌuhetoloina, sawasawahina ma deiuwa simiyatoi sabi loina, ꞌaigeda ꞌino ꞌebeulega ma ꞌaigeda ꞌino ꞌadigeyegeyega.”

Coinega Yesu loheloheyaedi ꞌihegwaediya, “Comi ꞌimi ꞌahwanoi bewa ꞌana nuwasabwalena geya wasanasanapu. Muya biyoina ꞌoinega yanuma, togidega, sawasawahina ꞌomi wete ꞌoinega wanuma?” Ma sigwae, “Sawasawahima.”

Ma Yesu ꞌigwaeya, “Moisa, biyoina ꞌoinega yanuma ꞌomi wete ꞌabwa wanuma, ma hesi geya sawasawahigu ma yahesinuwa taiyawedi ꞌabwa ꞌigu hetoloina ꞌoina ꞌigu ꞌebeulega ma ꞌigu ꞌadigeyegeyega simiyatoi sabi loina, weyahina Tamagu ꞌiboimo ꞌabwa ꞌihesinuwa.”
Ma tomuliyao site teniyedi Yemesa ma Yoni ꞌidi ꞌahwanoi sihesagoheya, ma sigamwasowalediya.
Coinega Yesu mabwaiyadi ꞌibwau heꞌautediya, ma ꞌihegwaediya, “Comi wasanapuya ꞌabehega babadao baleꞌuwa ꞌidi loheloheyao siloiloina paꞌaledi,
ma ꞌomi sahena wete gide taudi wapaihowa ꞌese. Ma ꞌeguma taiya ꞌowa nuwanuwau ma ꞌoimiyega ꞌuhetoloina, ꞌilobwainegowa ma ꞌiyamwao weyahidi ꞌuhetopaihowa.
“Ma wete ꞌeguma taiya ꞌowa nuwanuwau ma ꞌoimiyega ꞌuhetohanugeta ꞌilobwainegowa ma ꞌiyamwao weyahidi ꞌuhetopaihowa.

Wete gide taugu Loheyaiguina yasuluma baleꞌuwa, geya ꞌabehega tomota weyahigu sipaihowa, ma hesi sabi paihowa tomota weyahidi, ma wete yatagwalegauwa ma yaꞌamasa tomota mabwaiyami ꞌami lihasa weyahina.”
Tomatagibu ꞌeluwa Yesu ꞌiꞌabihe bwebweꞌanediya
Coinega Yeliko siꞌebesineya ma boda madouna Yesu simuliyeya.
Ma loheya tomata gibugibu ꞌeluwa ꞌeda papalina simiyatoiya, Yesu ꞌina sakowasi wasana sihesagoheya, ꞌoinega Yesu ꞌoina sibwauwa, “Debida tubuna yo, ꞌuꞌatemuyemuyemai.”
Ta boda siteluwaedi ꞌenadi sihesagoheya, ma siꞌetobodediya, sigwae, “Walolagu! Tuwa bwau.” Ma ꞌoinega siteluwaedi sibwaubwau ꞌoheꞌohe, sigwae, “Bada, Debida tubuna yo, ꞌuꞌatemuyemuyemai.”
Coinega Yesu ꞌitoholowa ta ꞌibwauwedima ta ꞌigwaeya, “Toꞌaha nuwanuwami ma weyahimi yapaihowa?”
Ma sigwaeya, “Bada, sawasawahina ma matama ꞌuꞌabihe bwebweꞌanedi?”
Ma Yesu ꞌiꞌatemuyemuyediya, ma matadi ꞌiꞌabitohodiya, ma sibwebweꞌana, ma ꞌoinega Yesu wete simuliyeya.
